import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

    for v in row:
        if not (pd.isna(v) or (isinstance(v, str) and v.strip() == "")):
            return False
    return True

    for c in range(cols, 4):
        kept[c] = np.nan

if len(kept) >= target_rows:
    out_df = kept.iloc[:target_rows].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
else:
    # append blank rows to reach target_rows
    n_missing = target_rows - len(kept)
    pad = pd.DataFrame([[np.nan]*4]*n_missing)
    out_df = pd.concat([kept, pad], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are exactly 4 and ordered A-D as 0..3

# Create parent directory if needed and save

def is_blank_row(row):
    for v in row:
        if not (pd.isna(v) or (isinstance(v, str) and v.strip() == "")):
            return False
    return True

blank_mask = df.apply(is_blank_row, axis=1)
kept = df.loc[~blank_mask].reset_index(drop=True)

# Prepare new DataFrame of exactly 384 rows x 4 cols for A1:D384
target_rows = 384
cols = kept.shape[1]
if cols < 4:
    # ensure there are 4 columns
    for c in range(cols, 4):
        kept[c] = np.nan

if len(kept) >= target_rows:
    out_df = kept.iloc[:target_rows].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
else:
    # append blank rows to reach target_rows
    n_missing = target_rows - len(kept)
    pad = pd.DataFrame([[np.nan]*4]*n_missing)
    out_df = pd.concat([kept, pad], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are exactly 4 and ordered A-D as 0..3

# Create parent directory if needed and save
